name: Sepia Examples
description: Reference plugin demonstrating every hook and host capability. Safe by default: rewriting hooks stay inert until you opt in via Configure.

model.description: Rewrite the inbound model to this value before routing (empty = no rewrite).

system.description: Override the system prompt before routing (empty = keep original).

max_tokens.description: Cap max_tokens before routing (0 = keep original).

exclude.description: Provider ids to exclude from routing, e.g. [2, 5].

reverse_candidates.description: Reverse the candidate order (strategy hook demo).

add_header.description: Add an x-sepia-plugin: example header to upstream requests.

response_marker.description: Append this marker to each response choice's content (empty = no rewrite).
